name: RoutineSpec
description:
RoutineSpec defines what a routine runs and, optionally, when it runs on
 its own.

 The spec is deliberately small: the agent and message each run starts
 from, an optional cron expression, the IANA time zone the routine keeps,
 and the owner's enablement switch. Everything the platform observes about
 firing lives in status, so a declarative apply can never clobber it.

fields.name: Cron
fields.description:
When the routine runs on its own: a cron expression in the classic
 5-field form (minute, hour, day-of-month, month, day-of-week),
 evaluated in `time_zone`, for example "0 9 * * *" for daily at 09:00.
 The shorthands @hourly, @daily, @weekly, @monthly, and @yearly are also
 accepted. Time zone prefixes (CRON_TZ=/TZ=), @every intervals, 6- or
 7-field forms, and trailing comments are rejected. Absent, the routine
 runs only when it is fired.

fields.name: TimeZone
fields.description:
IANA time zone the routine keeps, e.g. "Asia/Kolkata": its schedule is
 evaluated in it, and every run is told the date and time in it. Required
 when `cron` is set; empty without one means UTC.

fields.name: Enabled
fields.description:
Whether the routine runs. Off stops it from running on its schedule and
 refuses fire, without deleting the routine or its history.

fields.name: Agent
fields.description: The agent each run starts, with the message it starts from.
